privit.rule.manage.description:
Manage region
If this rule is §n§aon§r, members of this
group can:
- change the region boundaries
- change the name and color of the region
- create / edit / delete groups and rules
- add / remove players from groups
§8(Cannot be turned off, or you will lose edit permission)
privit.rule.pvp.description:
PvP
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot:
- deal damage to other players
- take damage from other players
privit.rule.build.description:
Break and place blocks
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot place or break blocks,
as well as place or destroy decorative
entities (armor stands, paintings,
item frames, etc.)
§8(Explosions are not checked by this rule)
privit.rule.drop_and_pickup_items.descri:
Drop and pick up items
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot drop or pick up items
in this region.
privit.rule.attack_passive_mobs.descript:
Attack passive mobs
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot damage passive mobs
and entities in this region.
privit.rule.cause_explosions.description:
Cause explosions
If this rule is §n§coff§r, any explosions
caused by members of this group will
have no effect on blocks or entities
inside the region.
Protection applies to:
- TNT / bed / respawn anchor activation
- creeper ignition / provocation
- wither creation
- ghast fireballs
privit.rule.interact_with_animals.descri:
Interact with animals
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot interact with animals
in this region.
privit.rule.trade_with_villagers.descrip:
Trade with villagers
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot trade with villagers
in this region.
privit.rule.set_respawn_point.descriptio:
Set respawn point
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use beds or respawn anchors
to set a respawn point in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_containers.des:
Interact with containers
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot open containers (chests,
barrels, etc.).
Ender chests are not affected.
Creating double chests and attaching
hoppers is also blocked.
privit.rule.interact_with_doors.descript:
Interact with doors
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot open or close doors
in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_trapdoors.desc:
Interact with trapdoors
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot open or close trapdoors
in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_fence_gates.de:
Interact with fence gates
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot open or close fence gates
in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_levers.descrip:
Interact with levers
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot toggle levers
in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_signs.descript:
Interact with signs
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot edit text on signs
in this region.
privit.rule.interact_with_boats.descript:
Interact with boats
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot interact with any boats
in this region:
- place boats by hand or dispenser
- break boats
- board and control boats
- push boats
privit.rule.interact_with_minecarts.desc:
Interact with minecarts
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot interact with any minecarts
in this region:
- place minecarts by hand or dispenser
- break minecarts
- board and control minecarts
- push minecarts
privit.rule.use_fluids.description:
Use fluids
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot place or remove fluids
in this region.
Fluids placed outside will not flow in.
Attempts to melt ice blocks inside
the region are also prevented.
privit.rule.press_buttons.description:
Press buttons
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot interact with buttons
in this region:
- press buttons by hand
- activate pressure plates
privit.rule.use_leashes.description:
Use leashes
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use leashes in this region:
- leash entities
- the leash will break if the player
  walks through the region while holding
  a leashed entity
privit.rule.use_fishing_rods.description:
Use fishing rods
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use fishing rods
in this region:
- casting is blocked
- attempts to cast a line onto the
  region territory are interrupted
privit.rule.use_fire_starters.descriptio:
Use fire starters
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot start fires in this region:
- with flint and steel, fire charges, etc.
  by hand or dispenser
- fire created outside by these members
  will not spread into the region
privit.rule.use_frost_walker.description:
Use Frost Walker
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot freeze water using the
Frost Walker enchantment in this region.
privit.rule.use_spawn_eggs.description:
Use spawn eggs
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot spawn mobs with spawn eggs
(by hand or dispenser) in this region.
privit.rule.use_sponges.description:
Use sponges
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot absorb water with sponges
in this region.
privit.rule.use_trial_mechanics.descript:
Use trial mechanics
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot:
- open trial vaults
- use trial spawners
privit.rule.use_pistons.description:
Use pistons
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use pistons in this region:
- pistons cannot push blocks into
  the region
- sticky pistons cannot pull blocks
  out of the region
privit.rule.extinguish_fire.description:
Extinguish fire
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot extinguish fires or
campfires in this region.
privit.rule.throw_potions.description:
Throw potions
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use splash or lingering
potions in this region:
- they cannot be thrown by hand or
  dispenser inside the region
- potions thrown from outside have
  no effect on entities inside
privit.rule.throw_ender_pearls.descripti:
Throw ender pearls
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use ender pearls
in this region:
- they cannot be thrown inside the region
- pearls thrown from outside will not
  teleport the player if the landing
  point is inside the region
privit.rule.throw_wind_charges.descripti:
Throw wind charges
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use wind charges
in this region:
- they cannot be thrown by hand or
  dispenser inside the region
- the explosion has no effect on blocks
  or entities inside the region
privit.rule.throw_snowballs.description:
Throw snowballs
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use snowballs
in this region:
- they cannot be thrown by hand or
  dispenser inside the region
- snowballs thrown from outside have
  no effect on blocks or entities
privit.rule.throw_eggs.description:
Throw eggs
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use eggs in this region:
- they cannot be thrown by hand or
  dispenser inside the region
- eggs thrown from outside have
  no effect on blocks or entities
privit.rule.eat_chorus_fruits.descriptio:
Eat chorus fruit
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use chorus fruit
in this region:
- it cannot be eaten inside the region
- eating it outside will not teleport
  the player into the region
privit.rule.create_nether_portals.descri:
Use nether portals
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot use nether portals
in this region:
- cannot teleport to another dimension
  from inside the region
- a new portal will not be generated
  inside the region when arriving from
  another dimension
privit.rule.push_entities.description:
Push entities
If this rule is §n§coff§r, members of this
group cannot push entities inside
the region.
§8(Minecarts and boats are not
§8affected by this rule)
privit.rule.spread_sculk.description:
Sculk spread
If this rule is §n§coff§r, sculk whose
spread was started by members of this
group will not spread into the region.
